records.rationale: Human secure: constant time string comparison.
AI naive: inverted strcmp authentication check.
Human remediation: fixed strcmp logic.
AI edit: prefix match vulnerability.
Human base implementation with Numeric Truncation Error vulnerability.
AI naive generation with Numeric Truncation Error defensive guard.
Human developer remediation addressing Numeric Truncation Error concerns.
AI coding assistant edit introducing subtle Numeric Truncation Error boundary regression.
Human secure: bounded fgets.
AI naive: banned gets function.
Human remediation: replaced gets with bounded fgets.
AI edit: scanf %s without width specifier.
Human legacy flaw: mismatch between allocation size and copy byte count.
AI defensive generation: allocates for total samples and bounds copies safely.
Human edit regression: reinstated undersized allocation during manual tuning.
AI assistant remediation: fixes heap buffer calculation and zeroes padding.
Human secure: uses atomic O_EXCL open.
AI naive: access() followed by open() is vulnerable to symlink race condition.
Human remediation: atomic O_CREAT | O_EXCL | O_NOFOLLOW.
AI edit: replaced access with stat, still subject to TOCTOU.
Human secure: strict digit check and range validation.
AI naive: atoi without validation.
Human remediation: strtol with endptr check and 1-65535 boundary check.
AI edit: omitted port range limit.
Human base implementation with Unchecked Return Value defensive guard.
AI naive generation with Unchecked Return Value vulnerability.
Human developer remediation addressing Unchecked Return Value concerns.
AI coding assistant edit introducing subtle Unchecked Return Value boundary regression.
Human secure: verifies packet buffer has at least 4 bytes before indexed read.
AI naive: reads beyond packet buffer on small packets.
Human remediation: inserted bounds check pkt_len < 4.
AI partial check: only checks pkt_len == 0, still permitting OOB reads.
